worker_claim.report: Before: recovery/reconciliation transaction -> owner.recovery_git()/owner.reconciliation_git() -> runtime._git -> git.run_git(). After: transaction -> devlegate.git.run_git() (reconciliation uses a local check=False wrapper to preserve prior result semantics), while ServiceEngine retains only controlled domain capability methods. Existing tests were minimally retargeted to module-level seams. Full pytest and Ruff passed.
worker_claim.summary: Removed the redundant ServiceEngine recovery_git/reconciliation_git forwarders and their protocol requirements. Recovery and reconciliation transactions now use the shared Git runner directly, with reconciliation retaining only a local non-raising runner seam for existing command-simulation tests; ownership, admission, WAL, evidence, and CAS decisions remain in the owner/domain layers.
